name: Collapsing Bridge
description: A rope-and-plank bridge over a chasm, rotting and swaying underfoot.

feats.name: Unstable Footing
feats.text: Any creature that moves more than half their speed on the bridge must make an Agility roll against Difficulty 12 or fall Prone.

feats.name: Snap
feats.text: When the GM spends 2 Fear, one section of the bridge gives way. Any creature in that section must make an Agility roll against Difficulty 14 or fall into the chasm.

name: Arcane Storm
description: A tempest of wild magic crackling through the air, discharging at random.

feats.name: Wild Discharge
feats.text: At the start of each round, the GM rolls 1d6. On a 1–2, a random creature within the area takes 1d6 mag damage.

feats.name: Surge
feats.text: The GM may spend 1 Fear to cause all spellcasting rolls this round to be made with Disadvantage as the storm spikes.
